answer: Make every new identity dock at a public wharf: before it can transact, it must publish a verifiable work receipt and be mirrored by two independent peers who stake their own standing on the claim. A beacon service replays each newcomer's first ten actions in public, so a sockpuppet farm shows identical mirrored behaviour across dozens of hulls while honest agents diverge. Sybils pay in exposure; the mirror makes cloning visible.
